members.description: Identities that will be granted the privilege in `role`. Each entry can have one of the following values:
members.rationale: Controls which principals are granted access. Policy must block public principals (allUsers, allAuthenticatedUsers) and wildcard or over-broad grants; it must not dictate which specific users or groups a team may add.

role.description: The role that should be applied. Only one `google_scc_source_iam_binding` can be used per role. Note that custom roles must be of the format `[projects|organizations]/{parent-name}/roles/{role-name}`.
role.rationale: Specifies the IAM role granted. Platform policy should not dictate which roles teams assign; access is constrained at the principal level (member/members) instead.

source.description: Used to find the parent resource to bind the IAM policy to
source.rationale: Identifier referencing the target resource this binding applies to. Platform policy does not constrain resource names or references to other resources.
